meta.scope: Iran Batch 6 — Health, water stress / climate, and Russia partnership densification.

candidates.title: Health and vital statistics (life expectancy, mortality)
candidates.publisher: SCI / Ministry of Health related / WHO-aligned
candidates.description: Core health outcome statistics including life expectancy at birth, child and adult mortality indicators. Life expectancy has reached the mid-to-high 70s in recent estimates.

candidates.title: Water resources and water-stress statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and FAO AQUASTAT-aligned sources
candidates.description: Renewable water resources, withdrawal by sector, and water-stress indicators. Iran faces high water stress (agricultural withdrawal dominant); drought and groundwater depletion are recurring constraints on agriculture and urban supply.
candidates.notes: High-centrality environmental constraint node for a water-stressed economy.

candidates.title: Climate and drought framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from meteorological and agricultural sources
candidates.description: Policy and analytical framing of climate variability, drought frequency and their impacts on agriculture, water resources and rural livelihoods. Continuously referenced in food-security and adaptation discussions.
candidates.notes: Climate-risk densification linked to the water and agriculture clusters.

candidates.title: Iran–Russia economic and strategic partnership framing
candidates.description: Economic and strategic partnership framing with Russia, including trade, industrial cooperation, EAEU-related arrangements and broader geopolitical alignment. Complements the China oil corridor as a second major external relationship under sanctions.
candidates.notes: Second major external-partner densification after China.

candidates.title: Iran health–water–Russia densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from health, water and partnership sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding health/vital statistics, water resources and water-stress indicators, climate/drought framing, and Iran–Russia partnership framing into a coherent health–environment–external layer.
